# Royal World Scraps

> Royal World Scraps buys old, used, damaged and non-working air conditioners and AC scrap in Mumbai and nearby areas.

## Contact
- Phone: +91 95943 88214
- WhatsApp: +91 72083 89614
- Email: contact@royal-world.in
- Location: Ghatkopar West, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Service area: Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Kalyan. Confirm service availability for your specific location.

## How to sell an old AC
Share your location, AC type, quantity and condition by phone, WhatsApp or the enquiry form. Royal World Scraps discusses pricing based on the equipment, quantity and condition, then confirms whether collection can be arranged. Prices and collection are confirmed after assessment.
